parameters.name: AgentId
parameters.description: Optional. The agent ID. You can use the ID of an agent that is automatically generated when you enable DAS Agent, or the ID of a custom agent. If this parameter is omitted, the default agent is used.

parameters.name: SessionId
parameters.description: Optional. The session ID, which must be a UUID. If unspecified, a new session is created. To maintain conversational context, use the same session ID for all subsequent requests.

parameters.name: Summary
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return summary information.
